decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY covering reuse of the existing spreadsheet and separate TikTok Shop and website areas. The source event's product-coverage change applies specifically to TikTok Shop listing and does not require an additional spreadsheet-state change.
The instruction to list every product is explicitly limited to TikTok Shop. Mentioning a website area in the tracking spreadsheet does not change the website product-listing requirement.
Requiring every selected product to be listed in TikTok Shop does not change how products are selected from CJ Dropshipping or the evidence used for selection.
The Google Drive social content bank is unrelated to TikTok Shop product-listing coverage and catalog spreadsheet organization.
Daily social post scheduling and publishing remains unchanged by the TikTok Shop product-listing coverage decision.
